hero.headline: Addiction Treatment Serving Des Moines, Iowa
hero.subhead: Our Johnston campus sits about 15 minutes from downtown Des Moines — close enough for family to stay involved, far enough to give you room to focus.

image.alt: Aerial view of the Des Moines skyline

sections.heading: Treatment for Des Moines, from our Johnston campus
sections.subheading: Care in your own city, without leaving your support system behind
body: Most people looking for addiction treatment in Des Moines are weighing two bad options: a facility so close that every trigger is still on the doorstep, or one so far away that family involvement stops being realistic. Our Johnston campus sits between those extremes — roughly 15 minutes from downtown, straight up I-35 or Merle Hay Road.

That distance matters clinically. It is far enough to break the daily routine that keeps substance use going, and near enough that a partner, parent or adult child can attend family sessions on a weeknight without booking travel. When treatment ends, you are already in the community where you will do the work of staying well.

sections.heading: Every Level of Care in One Place
sections.subheading: You move between levels without changing facility, insurer or clinical team.

items.title: Medical Detox
items.text: 24/7 supervised withdrawal management, the safe first step when there is physical dependence.

items.title: Residential Inpatient
items.text: Live on site with round-the-clock support, for substance use and mental health alike.

items.title: Intensive Outpatient (IOP)
items.text: Part-day sessions while you live at home and keep working or studying.

items.title: Outpatient
items.text: Continuing care as your weekly commitment scales back.

items.title: Virtual Outpatient
items.text: The same clinicians by secure video, if getting to campus is the obstacle.

items.title: Dual Diagnosis
items.text: Addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions treated together, not in sequence.

sections.heading: Getting here from Des Moines
body: We are at 5820 Winwood Dr, Johnston, IA 50131. From downtown Des Moines it is about 15 minutes: north on I-35/80 to the Merle Hay Road exit, then a short run north-west. From the East Village or Drake allow a little longer in rush hour. Parking is on site and free, and if transport is the thing standing in your way, say so when you call — we can often help arrange it.

faqs.q: Is the facility actually in Des Moines?
faqs.a: The campus is in Johnston, about 15 minutes from downtown Des Moines, and we serve the whole metro from there. We say Johnston plainly rather than claiming a Des Moines address, because you should know exactly where you are going before you commit to treatment.

faqs.q: Can my family visit during treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, and we actively encourage it. Family involvement is one of the strongest predictors of lasting recovery, and being 15 minutes from Des Moines means a weeknight family session is realistic rather than an all-day undertaking.

We work with most major private plans, including Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, UMR, UnitedHealthcare and Surest. Verification is free, confidential and takes minutes — we will tell you your coverage, deductible and any co-pay before you commit to anything.

faqs.q: How quickly can I be admitted?
faqs.a: Often the same day. Admissions are answered 24/7, and if we are not the right fit for your clinical needs we will tell you and help you find somewhere that is.

sections.heading: Start treatment in Des Moines today
body: One confidential call is enough to understand your options, check your insurance and decide on a next step. No obligation to enrol.
